compiled_state.title: story-decomposer test-index: RED marker [test_delta_output_mode_section_exists] -> bracket not removed after GREEN merge
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** f3cf9bcab88149c8aeece97f130a2ce0224e5232
* **Plugin/Tool Versions:** dso plugin v1.17.23
* **Context Scope:** session branch worktree-20260522-180209 of sprint epic 81d7-9da2-676e-4948; .test-index line 50

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** User-Flagged Behavior

#### Expected Behavior

Per the TDD workflow documented in .claude/docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md and the scan-red-markers.sh CI gate behavior: when a RED test's GREEN implementation has landed, the bracket-enclosed marker pattern '[test_name_here]' MUST be removed from the .test-index entry. scan-red-markers.sh runs at the session→main CI gate (red-test-blocker job) and exits 1 when any undeferred RED marker is present in the merged .test-index, blocking the cumulative session→main merge.

#### Actual Behavior

PR #292 (story a7c0-8e53-3502-4ddd) merged with the bracket still present. .test-index:50:

```
plugins/dso/agents/story-decomposer.md:tests/scripts/test-story-decomposer-remediation.sh [test_delta_output_mode_section_exists]
```

The GREEN implementation (DELTA OUTPUT MODE section in story-decomposer.md, commit 26d7eb9b04) shipped without the corresponding .test-index cleanup. This was caught by the compensating local code review (PR #292 review, REVIEWER_HASH=d6cfdd713b5e7f47), not by automated test coverage — the project does not currently have a hook that catches "GREEN implementation landed but RED marker still present in .test-index" at story-level closure.

### 3. Action History and Workarounds

* **Steps Taken:**
  * .claude/scripts/dso ticket transition a7c0-8e53-3502-4ddd in_progress closed → ab28-87ea-8140-4452 (closure verifier P1=PASS, did not check .test-index marker state)
  * merge-to-main.sh BRANCH=story/.../a7c0 STORY_PR_BASE=worktree-20260522-180209 → PR #292 auto-merged
  * Local code-reviewer-standard caught the issue post-merge
* **Known Workarounds:** Edit .test-index to remove the bracket; commit on session branch.

### 5. Skills and Workflows

* **Active Workflow:** /dso:sprint Phase F → story closure → PR-merge to session
* **Skills Invoked:** dso:completion-verifier (P1=PASS); dso:code-reviewer-standard (caught the issue post-merge)

### 6. Logs

Reviewer finding (severity=important, category=correctness):
> The GREEN implementation (DELTA OUTPUT MODE section) was merged in this PR without removing the TDD RED marker from .test-index. The entry 'plugins/dso/agents/story-decomposer.md:tests/scripts/test-story-decomposer-remediation.sh [test_delta_output_mode_section_exists]' still carries the '[test_delta_output_mode_section_exists]' RED-phase bracket. scan-red-markers.sh runs at the session→main CI gate (red-test-blocker) and exits 1 when any undeferred RED marker is present in the merged .test-index.
